package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"reflect"
)

// scenario for reflection_hot_path: reflect package calls inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type Rule630PositiveHandler struct{}

func (h *Rule630PositiveHandler) GetValue() string {
	return "ok"
}

func scenario630Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	handler := &Rule630PositiveHandler{}
	obj := reflect.ValueOf(handler)
	method := obj.MethodByName("GetValue")
	result := method.Call(nil)
	w.Write([]byte(result[0].String()))
}
